subject: Deployment of Acoustic Doppler current profiler - Halifax Harbour and Approaches
text:
Deployment of Acoustic Doppler current profiler - Halifax Harbour and Approaches
Deployment of an Acoustic Doppler Current Profiler in 44 39.445N 063 33.565W, connected with a communications cable to the South finger pier of COVE in Dartmouth. Maximum height of the array off of the seafloor is 2 metres. Caution.
